h1.en: Prestressed concrete illustrates the note on an S-Valve Name Does Not Specify
h1.zh: 「預力混凝土」用来说明S阀这个名称没有写明什么

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery uses the words S-valve and S-tube for concrete pump wear parts made in Xingtai. The parts category calls them S-valve wear parts. The picture is from https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Prestressed_concrete.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械用 S阀 和 S管 来称呼在邢台生产的混凝土泵易损件。分体活塞一行写明用于 S阀混凝土泵，另一行写出 S管密封。图片来自https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Prestressed_concrete。

body.en: Downloaded from https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Prestressed_concrete. The image subject is Prestressed concrete. Hebei Pinjin Machinery uses the words S-valve and S-tube for concrete pump wear parts made in Xingtai. Those names mark a circuit. A hopper on a pump sheet is still a hopper entry. Together they are the published vocabulary. The S-valve name does not replace them.
body.zh: 此图下载自https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Prestressed_concrete。画面内容是Prestressed concrete。河北品锦机械用 S阀 和 S管 来称呼在邢台生产的混凝土泵易损件。目录还写出主油缸密封、摆缸密封和摆臂球头。

body.en: The parts category calls them S-valve wear parts. They do not list a swing angle, a bore, a stroke or a replacement sequence. An S-tube seal name does not add a hopper volume. Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not list the degrees of swing or the order of movement. For a size the parts page does not need this article to repeat, open the part page itself or /en/contact/.
body.zh: 分体活塞一行写明用于 S阀混凝土泵，另一行写出 S管密封。动力、理论输送量、写出了的压力，以及这台混凝土泵上的距离标题，仍然是性能格。

heading.zh: 预应力筋耐久性与防腐

body.en: The split-piston line says the set is for S-valve concrete pumps, and a separate line names an S-tube seal. They appear on the concrete pump parts category and on the named wear-part pages, not as a timed diagram on Electric 20 or Diesel 40. The catalogue also names a main-cylinder seal, a swing-cylinder seal and a swing-arm ball. Power, theoretical output, pressure where shown, and the distance label on that concrete pump remain the performance entries.
body.zh: 它们出现在混凝土泵配件分类和点名的易损件页面上，不是电动20或柴油40上的节拍图。配件页上的尺寸不必在本文重复，请打开配件页或 /zh/contact/。

question.en: On this row: Does the pump sheet draw an S-valve cycle?
question.zh: 泵的参数页画了S阀循环吗？

answer.en: No. The cycle timing is not shown. The name is on the parts list. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Prestressed_concrete.
answer.zh: 没有。循环节拍没有写出。名称在配件清单上。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Prestressed_concrete画面里印出的数字。

question.en: On this row: Is a gate-valve model listed as a pump code?
question.zh: 有没有闸阀型号被列成泵的代号？

answer.en: The concrete pump rows do not list a gate-valve model code. The wear-part wording that is shown says S-valve. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Prestressed_concrete.
answer.zh: 混凝土泵各行没有标出闸阀型号代号。写出的易损件用词是 S阀。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Prestressed_concrete画面里印出的数字。

question.en: On this row: Does the S-tube name include a bore?

answer.en: No. Bore is not shown on the pump sheets or as part of that name. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Prestressed_concrete.
answer.zh: 不包含。泵的参数页没有标出缸径，名称里也没有。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Prestressed_concrete画面里印出的数字。

question.en: On this row: Where is the S-valve wording published?

answer.en: On the concrete pump parts category and the piston and S-tube pages of Hebei Pinjin Machinery. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Prestressed_concrete.
answer.zh: 在河北品锦机械的混凝土泵配件分类，以及活塞和 S管页面上。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Prestressed_concrete画面里印出的数字。
